1. You're a content creator and you're starting a live stream.
2. You just uploaded a new video.
3. You just uploaded a new fanfiction/comic.
4. You enter the forum, many threads pop up.
5. You enter one of the many chat rooms.
6. Just another day at the site, content gets uploaded, lots of chatting, etc.

Open to more suggestions for more greetings!
